title: Action
description: One edit to the OKR document: either to a node in the tree or to a team in company.units. The op decides which fields are allowed; anything not listed for that op is rejected.

oneOf.description: Change the content of an existing node.
Move an existing node under a different parent.
Remove a node and everything under it.
Change an existing team: its name, where it sits in the org, or its charter.
Create a team that does not exist yet.
Remove a team. Its nodes are kept and simply lose their team.

nodeId.description: Id of the node this action applies to.

unitId.description: Id of the team in company.units this action applies to.

editableFields.title: EditableFields
editableFields.description: The fields an edit or relink may set. Every one is optional, but at least one must be present.

label.description: New label. State the outcome, not the activity.

owner.description: New owning team or person, as display text. Prefer unitId when the owner is one of the teams in company.units; owner is filled in from the team's name.

unitId.description: Id of the team in company.units that should own this node, or null to un-assign it. Setting this fills owner in from the team's name.

metric.description: New metric: the quantity being moved, named precisely enough to look up.

target.description: New target, with a baseline, a goal and a date, for example "31% -> 50% by Q4".

contributes.description: New alignment score (0-1). Raise it when a fix makes the node genuinely support its parent.

parent.description: New parent id. Must be an existing node that is not a descendant of this one.

addFields.title: AddFields
addFields.description: The fields a new node may be created with. Only label is required; everything else falls back to a default.

level.description: Where the new node sits. Defaults to kr.

label.description: What the new node is trying to achieve. Required.

owner.description: Owning team or person, as display text. Prefer unitId when the owner is one of the teams in company.units.

unitId.description: Id of the team in company.units that owns the new node, or null for none. Setting this fills owner in from the team's name.

contributes.description: How well the new node supports its parent (0-1).

parent.description: Id of the parent the new node hangs off. Must already exist.

unitFields.title: UnitFields
unitFields.description: The fields an editUnit may set on an existing team. Every one is optional, but at least one must be present.

name.description: New display name for the team, for example "Field Marketing".

parent.description: Id of the team this one now sits under, or null to move it to the top of the org. Must be an existing team that is not below this one.

lead.description: Id of the person in company.people who leads the team.

charter.description: Charter fields to change. Merged into the team's existing charter one field at a time, so sending only mission leaves process, owns and dependsOn as they were.

addUnitFields.title: AddUnitFields
addUnitFields.description: The fields a new team may be created with. Only name is required.

name.description: Display name for the new team. Required.

parent.description: Id of the team the new one sits under, or null for the top of the org. Must already exist.

charter.description: The new team's charter, if the user has said enough about how it works to write one.

editUnitAction.title: EditUnitAction
editUnitAction.description: Change an existing team in company.units. Only change a charter when the user has told you something about how the team actually works; do not invent a mission for a team they merely mentioned.

id.description: Id of the team to edit. It must already exist in company.units.

addUnitAction.title: AddUnitAction
addUnitAction.description: Create a team that is not in company.units yet. Use it when the user describes a team the org chart does not have, not to rename one that already exists.

id.description: Id for the new team. Must be unique and read as a slug of its name, for example "field-marketing".

deleteUnitAction.title: DeleteUnitAction
deleteUnitAction.description: Remove a team from company.units. Nothing is deleted from the tree: the nodes it owned keep their owner text and simply lose their unitId, and any teams under it move up to its parent. Only when explicitly asked.

id.description: Id of the team to remove.

editAction.title: EditAction
editAction.description: Rewrite an existing node in place.

id.description: Id of the node to edit. It must already exist.

relinkAction.title: RelinkAction
relinkAction.description: Move a node under a different parent. Follow it with an edit that updates contributes for the new fit.

id.description: Id of the node to move. It must already exist.

fields.title: RelinkFields
fields.description: A relink must name the new parent.

parent.description: Id of the new parent. Must exist and must not be a descendant of the node being moved.

addAction.title: AddAction
addAction.description: Create a node that does not exist yet.

id.description: Id for the new node. Must be unique and read as "kr-<short-slug>" or "obj-<short-slug>".

deleteAction.title: DeleteAction
deleteAction.description: Remove a node and every node under it. Only when explicitly asked.

id.description: Id of the node to remove.
